digest.component_or_area: LLM completion workflow recovery and gate-error instrumentation
propositions: Step-budget exhaustion computes a repetition diagnostic (tool-call signatures, loop/explore counts) but the diagnostic is discarded before reaching the gate-error sidecar because failure_diagnostic is never set for budget paths prior to recovery.

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist filters out repetition keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) and the merge guard rejects list-valued fields, preventing the already-computed diagnostic from surviving the exception carry.

Operators manually escalate step budgets without observing the underlying repetition pattern, unable to distinguish tool-call loops from genuine budget exhaustion, because the diagnostic that would disambiguate is computed then discarded.

The gate_error_v1 sidecar is never written for budget failures because raise_completion_workflow_failure is only called when failure_diagnostic is truthy, which does not occur when budget exhaustion does not reach CompletionAgentStep._recover.

The operator-facing close-gate failure message lacks distinct-vs-total tool-call counts, making it impossible to determine if the failure is due to looping (high repetition) or insufficient budget without reading logs.
